cohort: 5801 mothers and their children in northeastern Pomerania, Germany
finding: Maternal age and BMI before pregnancy were the predominant risk factors for GDM, while higher income and education level were protective, and GDM was associated with increased risks of C-section, preterm birth, macrosomia, and neonatal hypoglycaemia.
mod_finding: GDM was associated with an increased risk of delivery by C-section.
